subject: Admin activity evidence — export format choices & scrub guidance
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@medicosys.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: MedicoSys Security Ops <security@medicosys.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Admin activity export formats and redaction options (SIG / SOC2)

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As we prepare the SIG and SOC 2 evidence bundle, the audit team asked for a concise description of what admin activity artifacts you can provide and the formats/choices for delivery. Specifically:

- What event types are included in "admin activity" exports (role changes, API keys, model deploys, operator sessions, console logins, etc.)?
- What export formats do you support (CSV, NDJSON, compressed tar, signed S3 URL, GCS)?
- Do you provide a manifest with checksums and an HMAC attestation?
- Can you scrub or redact PII/IP addresses prior to export? Any standard redaction options?
- What are retention defaults and the expected lead time to produce a full snapshot for an evidence request?

We also have a requirement to normalize times to UTC and include timezone/offset metadata for each event.

Could you send a short, pointed reply with the options so I can feed this to the auditors? If possible, attach a sample manifest or schema.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Security Controls Lead
MedicoSys
[External]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@medicosys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity export formats and redaction options (SIG / SOC2)

Elena — thanks, great questions. Below is a concise summary you can pass to auditors; I attached a small sample manifest and the NDJSON schema as well.

What we log (admin activity):
- Role and permission changes (grants, revokes, role assignments)
- Console sign-ins and session start/stop (with MFA flag)
- API key and credential lifecycle events (create, rotate, revoke)
- Model serving changes: model upload, version pin, rollback, and canary rollouts
- Configuration changes to routing/policy (routing rules, fallback policies)
- Operator actions that touch customer data export paths (create/export requests)
- System generated automated maintenance events (scheduled restarts)

Retention & aggregation:
- Raw per-event logs: default 90 days (tenant-hosted retention can be extended under Dedicated/Private contracts)
- Aggregated/attested summaries: 365 days (retention configurable, documented in contract)

Export formats & delivery options:
- NDJSON (recommended for fidelity) or CSV for tabular needs
- Compressed bundle (gz or zip) containing data + manifest (SHA256 per file)
- Delivery: presigned S3 URL (AWS), GCS signed link, or encrypted tarball delivered to a customer SFTP endpoint
- Optional packaging: chain-of-custody manifest (HMAC + signing key) and attested metadata file describing timezone normalization and sampling rules

PII/redaction options:
- Redaction profiles: none (raw), minimal (hash IP addresses), strict (remove/replace IPs, email local-parts, and replace free-text with token placeholders)
- We can apply automated redaction for common PII fields prior to export; anything custom (e.g., regex-based scrub) requires scope review and may add time

Time-to-produce & SLAs:
- Standard evidence snapshot: 48–72 business hours from signed evidence request (includes basic manifest & checksum)
- Large-scale historical extractions or scoped forensic pulls: timeline quoted after scoping (typically 3–7 business days)
- We provide an attested manifest and SHA256 checksums; supply chain HMAC signing is available for enterprise customers

Timezone & timestamps:
- All event timestamps are stored in UTC internally; exports include both UTC timestamps and an ISO8601 offset field when local timezone context exists

Next steps:
- Attached: admin_activity_sample_manifest.csv and export_schema_ndjson.txt (NDJSON field names and types).
- If MedicoSys needs IP redaction or a stricter scrub profile, reply with the redaction level and specific fields. We can start a scoped run once we have signed handoff (DocuSign link or email acceptance).

Happy to jump on a ten-minute call to walk this through with your auditors.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Compliance Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Park <elena.park@medicosys.com>

Subject: Re: Admin activity export formats and redaction options (SIG / SOC2)

Thanks Hannah — this is exactly the level of detail we needed. A couple quick clarifications: 

- We will request "strict" redaction for exported evidence (remove IPs and redact email local-parts) for the SOC 2 probe. Please confirm feasibility and whether that will alter expected turnaround.
- We need the manifest to include a per-file SHA256 and a top-level HMAC (attested) so our intake system can verify integrity.
- Chain-of-custody attestation: can you provide a short signed statement (PDF) confirming who prepared the export, the time window, and the method used (e.g., NDJSON export, gz compressed, SHA256 manifest)?

Also — can timestamps be normalized to UTC only (no local offset column) for auditor ingest?

If you can confirm the above and provide an estimated ready-by time, we will issue the evidence request and DocuSign the export-handshake.

Best,
Elena

Karthik / Laura — looping you in to action the MedicoSys request. Summary and asks below (MedicoSys is cc'd).

Scope: MedicoSys (DEAL-8342) requests an evidence export covering 2026-01-01 -> 2026-05-27, strict redaction profile (remove IPs, redact local-parts of emails), packaged NDJSON, gz compressed, with per-file SHA256 and a top-level HMAC-signed manifest. Timestamps normalized to UTC only. They also need a chain-of-custody attestation PDF listing preparer, extraction window, and method.

Karthik: please prepare a scoped export job with the following deliverables
- NDJSON files (one file per day or per 10M events, whichever is smaller)
- gz compressed bundle with filename convention: medicosys_admin_export_20260101-20260527_v1.tar.gz
- Per-file SHA256 manifest (admin_activity_sample_manifest.csv style) and top-level manifest.json that includes HMAC signature (we will use the export key for DEAL-8342)
- Apply "strict" redaction profile (IP fields removed, email local-part replaced with <redacted>)
- Ensure timestamps are output in UTC ISO8601 with trailing Z, no offset column
- ETA: please confirm expected wall-clock time (target 72 hours from signed request) and any blockers (retention window or archive retrieval).

Laura: please prepare the chain-of-custody attestation PDF and a short note on redaction approach for the auditors. Also include the HMAC verification steps (public key or verification URL) and sample verification commands for their intake team.

Marissa: please coordinate DocuSign for the export-handshake (include the standard export SRA + redaction addendum). Elena, we'll send the DocuSign link once we have Karthik's ETA.

Elena: thanks again — once Karthik confirms the job ETA we will send the DocuSign and proceed.

Hannah Schmitt
